name: Threads

counting.notes: UTF-8 EMOJI CATCH: Standard chars count as 1, but emojis consume their UTF-8 byte length (4 to 18 units for ZWJ/flag/skin-tone emojis). Text Attachments allow up to 10,000 chars.

hashtags.excessBehavior: Threads allows strictly 1 topic tag (<=50 chars); multiple #hashtags are unsupported or error via API.
hashtags.notes: Use 1 clean topic tag; Threads full-text search indexes normal prose.

links.recommendedStrategy: Lead with a conversational take that earns replies; put external links in the immediate reply to preserve reply velocity.
links.notes: Threads API enforces max 5 unique URLs per post. Bare link posts starve reply-velocity ranking.

oauth.gotcha: Meta 60-day long-lived token exchange (>24h old, before expiry); two-step media container publish requires polling status before finalize. API enforces 250 posts/24h rolling window, 1,000 replies/24h, 100 deletions/24h. Check quota via GET /{user-id}/threads_publishing_limit. Wait ~30s between container creation and publish for video.

sources: Meta for Developers Threads API Docs (500 chars, 10k Text Attachment, 5 unique URLs, 8MB image / 1GB video / 20 carousel items, 1 topic tag)
